entries.positive_observation: The retrieved raw preserves the yellow compact mascot head, green-ringed black eyes, one closed mouth, side/back hair, dark suit, white shirt and dark patterned tie. entries.alpha_decision: The native RGBA exterior and complete frame/note silhouette are acceptable on actual white/cyan/alpha inspection; alpha 254 is not itself a rejection ground. Rejection is for the visible RGB replacement of the source's two-plus-two irregular groups by three-plus-four repeated bars, not for near-opacity.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine tie motifs, individual note glyph identities and tiny frame texture cannot be resolved at 65x67. The rejection is for the clearly visible repeated dash count and grouping, not guessed writing or microscopic ornament.
